root_cause: Protected merge 7e03a846 changed social-recovery-runner source but not supabase/config.toml. GitHub received only the Supabase preview-branch check, which completed skipped with 'This git branch is not associated with any Supabase Branch', and production social-recovery-runner remained provider v28. The last proven production deployment commit 2b0539cb changed supabase/config.toml and produced the successful /project check.
prevention_rule: Authority-critical social Edge Functions must carry a production_source_git_blob marker in supabase/config.toml equal to git hash-object of the function entrypoint. Required CI fails closed on mismatch, so any function source change must also change config.toml and therefore enter Supabase GitHub Integration production admission.
